notes: Collection reads no longer synchronously rebuild an empty manifest index. Initial indexing is scheduled once through the existing background worker, including configuration and storage-availability changes.
Collection responses expose initial-index job state; the Library displays progress and reloads results after completion, ignoring outdated search requests.
UPC lookup waits for the owned index before contacting an external provider. Failed/interrupted scans stay visible for explicit retry; empty completed indexes do not repeatedly rescan.

Adds non-blocking request, owned-UPC, failed/retry and empty-index regressions plus executable JavaScript progress/error rendering tests in reliability CI. Complete local Python suite: 131 passed with warnings treated as errors.
